name: chatsync
description: Local HTTP bridge that lets a browser userscript (Tampermonkey) read editor context (active file, selection, problems) and apply AI-generated code blocks back into VSCode. CORS-ready, localhost-only, token protected.

commands.title: ChatSync: Show Connection Info (port + token + userscript)
ChatSync: Run Self-Test (curl the local API)

chatsync.enabled.description: Start the ChatSync local HTTP server when VSCode starts.

chatsync.port.description: TCP port for the local bridge server.

chatsync.portFallbackRange.description: If the port is busy, try up to N next ports (3847, 3848, ...). Set 0 to disable.

chatsync.host.description: Bind address. Keep 127.0.0.1 — 0.0.0.0 exposes the bridge to your whole LAN (not recommended).

chatsync.requireToken.description: Require the X-ChatSync-Token header (or ?token=) on every request except /health. Strongly recommended.

chatsync.token.description: Fixed token. Leave empty to auto-generate a stable token per machine (run 'ChatSync: Show Connection Info' to see it).

chatsync.allowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed by CORS. '*' matches any origin, '*.example.com' matches subdomains. Requests with a non-allowed Origin are rejected with 403.

chatsync.maxFileSizeKB.description: Skip files larger than this when returning content.

chatsync.maxContextChars.description: Hard cap on characters returned for a single file (content is truncated with a marker).

chatsync.applyMode.description: 'diff' opens a VSCode diff preview and waits for you to keep/revert. 'direct' writes the edit immediately (still undoable with Ctrl+Z).

chatsync.autoSave.description: Save the document after a direct apply.

chatsync.previewTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a diff preview stays pending before it is discarded.

chatsync.rateLimitPerMinute.description: Max requests per minute from localhost before returning 429.

chatsync.logRequests.description: Log every HTTP request to the ChatSync output channel.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-dependencies -o chatsync.vsix
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:userscript
